summary: Backend-only iteration 2 test run. 37/37 pytest cases pass against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Verified new /api/music endpoint (returns 10 tracks, all with id/title/url/cover/order and correctly ordered) and the Guruji image migration on startup: every guru_messages doc, every satsang session hosted by 'Guruji Sundar', and the 'Morning Awakening' meditation now use the new customer-assets Guruji image URL. Yoga sessions correctly retained their original covers (not overwritten). All existing 28 tests (auth OTP flow, profile, meditations, mantra, mood, diary CRUD, rank, live sessions, books+orders create/verify (MOCKED razorpay), guru messages/quote, Q&A, SOS, sleep content) still pass. MOCKED integrations: Razorpay verify auto-succeeds, SendGrid replaced by dev_otp.

minor.issue: Review stated meditation bell_default values were changed to seconds (0, 300, 900) but persisted DB still has old values [60, 90, 60, 45, 60, 120]. Seed only inserts when collection empty and NO startup migration exists for bell_default (unlike the cover-image migration). Fresh deploys will get new values; existing DBs (like this one) remain on old numbers. Priority: LOW-MED.
(Carried from iter1) dev_otp is returned whenever SendGrid send fails, not only when OTP_DEV_MODE=true. Gate strictly on OTP_DEV_MODE for production safety.
(Carried from iter1) Uses Pydantic v1 body.dict(); migrate to body.model_dump(exclude_none=True) for Pydantic v2.

action_items: Add a startup migration for meditation bell_default (mirroring the cover-image migration) or use replace_one/upsert on seed so existing DBs get the new second-based values (0, 300, 900). Example: db.meditations.update_many({title:'Anxiety Relief Breath'}, {'$set':{'bell_default':300}}) etc.
Optional: gate dev_otp response strictly on OTP_DEV_MODE=true.
Optional: switch body.dict() → body.model_dump() for Pydantic v2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~890 lines – past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, content, commerce, guru, media) as the surface area grows.

Seed pattern is idempotent-on-empty only. Any future data-shape change (like bell_default seconds, cover URLs) will require a matching update_many migration in on_startup – the guruji-image migration is a good pattern to follow.
Music seed uses only 2-3 real audio URLs shared across 10 tracks (OCEAN/RAIN/BOWL reused). Functional for MVP but users will hear duplicates – consider distinct sources long-term.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed – server seeds meditations, music (new), sleep_content, live_sessions, books, guru_messages, quotes, Q&A on startup; migration on_startup force-updates covers for guru_messages, satsang live_sessions, and Morning Awakening meditation to the new Guruji image. Test users created per-run with TEST_ prefix.

Fixtures user_session/auth_headers in conftest.py handle OTP login. Razorpay + SendGrid MOCKED. GURUJI_IMAGE constant is duplicated inside test_backend.py to keep test literal traceability.
